defect.summary: A FLOOR READER THAT REALLY THROWS ON /guard TURNS THE ACT INTO AN UNBOOKED 500, AND WHERE A CATCH DOES HOLD THE THROW, THE ACT CAN STILL PASS. SCOPE, RULED (Frank, board 2026-10-17 15:37Z, 'Throws only, as recommended'): T27 covers REAL THROWS ONLY; an unreadable declared book is not a throw and stays each reader's own typed NOT READABLE (condition 1, and the follow-on ceiling, condition 2). (1) every reader step in wire() without a seam try (condition 3: Eng, Sig, narrow-K/W/R/T, op1, op3, Gate 4, and every logFile.describe()) escapes wire() as a 500 SERVICE_FAULT with nothing booked (measured 2026-10-08 on 30af283 and 2026-10-16 on 2511dac, case (a); wire.ts unchanged 2511dac to ebbdbca). (2) Gate 2's harm and basket catches each call the reader AGAIN to compose their blind reading (wire.ts:2940, :2999), so a reader throw would throw from the catch; at ebbdbca readGate2Direction is one try round the whole function (gate2-direction/index.ts:1430-1435), so this path is defence in depth, not reachable from today's bytes. (3) a caught throw composes CANNOT_ASSESS, and under a pilot-shaped line a CANNOT_ASSESS below the line is PASS_BLIND, execute true (chokepoint/types.ts:254-256), which F6 (Frank 2026-10-09 16:02Z: 'an act whose reader threw is HELD regardless of pilot') requires T27 to close. (4) an unreadable RETIRED predecessor makes the predecessor walk throw (wire.ts:966, readFileSync outside any try; reached by a mode-000 regular file, since a directory is already a stub at :962), and the harm seam's catch then DISCARDS a computable ALARM read from the readable current book. This is the one place today where an unreadable book surfaces as a throw; under the ruled scope it becomes the typed G2_PREDECESSOR_NOT_READABLE, not a throw (condition 5).

conditions: 1 · SCOPE: REAL THROWS ONLY — FORK-1 RULED (Frank, board 2026-10-17 15:37Z, verbatim: 'Throws only, as recommended'). A THROW, for every condition below, is exactly: (i) a throw a SEAM try catches at a reader step in wire() (condition 3); (ii) a reader's OWN net: G1_READER_THREW, G2_READER_THREW, G4_READER_THREW, and any <READER>_THREW a reader's own whole-function try returns; (iii) a log's or book's ADAPTER throwing before any reading exists (v3 condition 10's case (c); the Gate 1 and Gate 2 book seams). NOT A THROW, and never in readerThrows: every typed NOT READABLE a reader already returns through its try path — SUBJECT_CHAIN_UNREADABLE, G2_PREDECESSOR_NOT_READABLE, a broken or unverified chain, a reader's own readability or configuration arm, Gate 1's permanent CANNOT_ASSESS. Those stay each reader's own typed reading and compose exactly as today, including PASS_BLIND below a pilot's line. The trigger is the readerThrows list (condition 6), never the blind class MISSING_CONFIGURATION (which throws and configuration gaps share) and never a CANNOT_ASSESS as such. ARM (the control, v4's case (b)): the declared book replaced by a directory -> SUBJECT_CHAIN_UNREADABLE, readerThrows EMPTY, under a pilot-shaped line PASS_BLIND, execute true, booked — today's behaviour, pinned. MUTANTS, each killed by that arm: readerThrows filled from blind codes; the hold keyed on the class MISSING_CONFIGURATION; the hold keyed on floor CANNOT_ASSESS.

2 · CEILING — NOT COVERED, FOLLOW-ON (Frank's word, board 2026-10-17 15:37Z). The audit's line, verbatim: 'an unreadable declared book stays each reader's own typed NOT READABLE.
